input.quote: IBM may cancel any and all Purchase Orders against this Agreement at any time. In the event IBM cancels Purchase Order as the result of MSL's default, no cancellation charge shall be applicable. IBM's termination of Purchase Orders for its convenience shall not relieve IBM of any cost reimbursements under the Price section.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties or minimum/early-termination fees on IBM, which meets the preferred position. IBM may cancel Purchase Orders at any time with no cancellation charge (§6.1), and the termination provisions (§§5.1–5.3, 5.2 b)) require only purchase of completed/partially completed Product and Parts at cost-based prices — actual-cost reimbursement rather than a liquidated sum. The formulaic amounts payable by IBM under §13.0 f) and Appendix 2 (requirements-accuracy liabilities applied to material cost) and premium-cost reimbursement under §9.0 compensate MSL for actual inventory/premium exposure caused by IBM forecast inaccuracy and are pricing/reimbursement mechanics, not penalties on breach; §13.2 e) expressly confirms IBM has no liability for unused flexibility. The express "penalty" mechanics (Shipment Profit Rate deductions at p0757, delivery performance under §§10.2/10.4) run against MSL and are welcome to us, so they are not flagged.
